text: Artificial Intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. These tasks include learning, problem-solving, and understanding language. Machine learning is a part of AI that allows computers to learn from data without being programmed for every situation. Deep learning, a more advanced form, uses large neural networks to handle complex tasks like image and speech recognition. Today, AI is part of our daily lives. It powers voice assistants, helps recommend films on streaming services, and even improves medical diagnosis. AI is changing the way we live and work.
